title: AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research
abstract: arXiv:2609.38445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points

translated_title: AIM：面向自动化研究的智能体式思想管理
translated_abstract: 前沿大语言模型正日益被用于通过迭代搜索实现科学研究自动化。我们区分了思想驱动的搜索与方案驱动的搜索，并识别出三个核心挑战：组织不断演进的研究思想、选择有前景的方向，以及维护思想与其实现之间的一致性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了智能体式思想管理器（AIM），这是一个用于在思想驱动的自动化研究中管理和探索研究方向的完全自主的框架。受贝叶斯优化启发，AIM 使用智能体式代理模型和智能体式采集机制来组织所发现的思想并指导其选择。方案审计器负责维护思想与方案之间的完整性，而资源规划器则在并行搜索分支之间自适应地分配剩余的实验预算。在 10 个 AutoLab 基准任务上的实验表明，AIM 比最强的基线方法高出 1.6 个百分点。
tldr: 提出了 AIM 框架，受贝叶斯优化启发，通过智能体式代理模型与采集机制、方案审计器和资源规划器，解决思想驱动自动化研究中组织演化思想、选择有前景方向以及维护思想-方案一致性的三大挑战，在 10 个 AutoLab 基准任务上超过最强基线 1.6 个百分点。
en_tdlr: AIM is a fully autonomous framework inspired by Bayesian optimization that uses agentic surrogate and acquisition mechanisms, a solution auditor, and a resource planner to organize evolving research ideas, select promising directions, and maintain idea-solution alignment, surpassing the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks.
